Meta.title: NEEDIT
Meta.description: Just ask. NEEDIT finds what you need nearby.

Common.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the item is no longer listed.

freshness.stale: Availability may be out of date

Home.headline: What do you need?
Home.voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot take voice input.
Home.voiceDenied: Allow the microphone to dictate a search.
Home.voiceNetwork: Voice search could not reach the speech service. Check the connection and try again.
Home.servicesTitle: What can we do for you?
Home.deliveryBody: Send groceries, parcels, gifts, and everyday essentials.
Home.fuelBody: Request petrol for your parked vehicle, wherever available.
Home.homeHelpBody: Book trusted help for quick jobs around your home.
Home.moreBody: Tell us what you need and we'll help you find the right service.
Home.locationHelp: Search or tap the map, then deliver to that pin.
Home.mapFailed: The map could not be loaded.
Home.mapDenied: Location permission is off. Drop a pin on the map.
Home.mapMissingKey: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY to show the map.
Home.promoHomeBody: Organizers and the small things you run out of.

Search.title: Search
Search.emptyHint: Try a product name, like a cable, notebook, or balloons.
Search.needPhrase: These are product matches from nearby stores. A suggested basket for a whole need is not part of this prototype.
Search.sorted: Best matches first, then faster nearby options.

Product.otherStoreTitle: Your cart is from another store
Product.otherStoreBody: One order is one store. Replace {store} with this item?
Product.closedNote: This store is closed. You can look, but checkout waits until it opens.
Product.unavailable: This item is out of stock.

Store.title: Store
Store.empty: This store has no listed products.
Store.closedNote: Closed right now. Products stay visible so you can see what they carry.

Cart.title: Cart
Cart.closed: This store is closed, so checkout is paused.

Checkout.title: Checkout
Checkout.instructionsHint: Optional. Gate code, floor, or where to leave the bag.
Checkout.codHelp: Pay the courier when the order arrives. Simulated in this prototype.
Checkout.demoNote: Demo only. No card is charged, and the full number is not stored.

errors.expiry: Enter a future expiry as MM/YY.
errors.closed: The store is closed, so this order cannot be placed.
errors.unavailable: An item in the cart is no longer available.
errors.mixed: The cart has items from more than one store.
errors.auth: Sign in with a customer account to place the order.
errors.invalid: Check the address and payment, then try again.

Order.title: Order
Order.tooLate: This order can no longer be cancelled.
Order.simulated: This order is only on this device, so the courier clock is a preview.
Order.savedNote: The store updates this order. A delivery partner takes it when it is ready.
Order.waitingPartner: A delivery partner picks this up when the store marks it ready.
Order.storeDistance: The store is {km} km from this address.
Order.trackInvalid: Check the address and phone, then try again.
Order.trackClosed: This order can no longer be changed.
Order.notFound: That order is not on this device.
Order.emailedBill: A copy of this bill is sent to your email.

detail.COURIER_ASSIGNED: A courier is heading to the store.
detail.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: It is on the way to you.

partnerStatus.PREPARING: The store is packing the order.
partnerStatus.COURIER_ASSIGNED: I am heading to the store.
partnerStatus.PICKED_UP: I have picked up your order.
partnerStatus.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: I have picked up your order, and I am on the way.
partnerStatus.REJECTED: The store could not take this order.
partnerStatus.FAILED: This order did not go through.

Services.deliveryIntro: Choose what you are sending, mark pickup and drop-off, and request a delivery.
Services.fuelIntro: Request fuel for a safely parked vehicle. A provider must review availability before confirmation.
Services.safetyBody: The vehicle must be outdoors, safely parked, switched off, cool, accessible, and away from flames, smoking, people, and enclosed parking.
Services.safetyAccept: I confirm the location is suitable and understand the provider may refuse an unsafe request.
Services.fuelEstimateNotice: Fuel and service prices are estimates only. No fuel is sold or charged until a licensed provider confirms availability and the final price.
Services.deliveryEstimateNotice: The displayed amount is an initial service estimate. Oversized, restricted, or special-handling items require review.
Services.signInRequired: Sign in with a customer account to request this service.
Services.invalid: Check the details and try again.
Services.failed: The request could not be sent.
Services.reviewNotice: We will review availability and confirm the final details before service begins.

Support.title: Help
Support.intro: Tell us what went wrong with an order. This stays on your device in the prototype.
Support.sent: Request {id} is saved on this device.

errors.message: Describe the issue in a few words.

delivery.a: Each store shows its own estimate. Once a delivery partner takes the order, the map follows their location.

area.a: The pilot is central Riyadh. One order comes from one store.

payment.a: Cash on delivery, or a demo card. No real charge is made.

cancel.a: You can cancel while the order is placed or just accepted. After preparation starts, this prototype will not cancel it.

Account.title: Account
Account.welcomeTitle: One friendly app for everyday needs.
Account.welcomeBody: Shop nearby, request a delivery, refill safely, and follow every step from one colorful place.
Account.privacyNote: By continuing, you agree to use NEEDIT responsibly. Your details are used to operate your requests and deliveries.
Account.guestBody: Orders are saved to your account. The cart stays on this device until you check out.
Account.name: Name
Account.exists: An account with that email already exists.
Account.resetSent: If that email has an account, we sent a reset link. It expires in 30 minutes.
Account.mailUnavailable: Email is not set up on the server yet, so the reset link cannot be sent.
Account.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
Account.resetDone: Password updated. Sign in with the new one.
Account.resetInvalid: That reset link is invalid or expired.

Merchant.title: Store orders
Merchant.intro: Accept an order, prepare it, then mark it ready for pickup.
Merchant.empty: No orders for this store yet.
Merchant.forbidden: This account is not a merchant.

Admin.title: Marketplace
Admin.intro: Track commerce, service delivery, customers, projected billing, and operating costs from one place.
Admin.costDisclaimer: Planning estimate based on configured costs—not an invoice or amount automatically charged.
Admin.notCollected: Projected values include demo and uncollected payments; they are not confirmed revenue.
Admin.forbidden: This account is not an admin.

Courier.title: Deliveries
Courier.intro: Find nearby deliveries, follow each stop, and keep customers updated while you move.
Courier.alertsBody: Get an alert as soon as an order is ready for pickup.
Courier.forbidden: This account is not a delivery partner.
Courier.emptyOpen: No orders are waiting for a partner.
Courier.sharingRoute: Location permission is off, so this device moves along the route.
Courier.sharingOff: Location sharing starts when you have an active delivery.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.enableHelp: Get an alert when the store accepts your order, when it is on the way, and when it arrives.
Notifications.blocked: This browser is blocking alerts. Allow notifications for NEEDIT in the site settings.
Notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot show system alerts. Updates still appear here.
Notifications.signIn: Sign in to get order alerts on this device.
